response:
It can be really frustrating and confusing to feel like you're eating very little yet still gaining weight. There are many possible reasons this can happen, including slowed metabolism from restricted eating, hormonal imbalances (like thyroid issues), stress, certain medications, or your body holding onto calories in response to perceived scarcity. It's also possible that what feels like "hardly eating" may still include enough calories to maintain or gain weight, depending on the foods involved.

Because weight changes can be tied to complex medical factors, it's a good idea to talk with a healthcare provider who can help you understand what's happening in your body. They can check for underlying conditions and help you find a balanced approach to eating that supports your health. You deserve to feel well and have answers, so please consider reaching out to a professional who can support you.
